data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 – Refund of €669.00
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterweiler issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the calendar year 2025, dated 28 July 2026, based on the tax return submitted via ELSTER. It sets a taxable income of €36,364 and grants a refund of €669.00 to be transferred to the stated bank account.
data.explanation: Finanzamt Musterweiler processed your 2025 income tax return and calculated a refund of €669.00, which will be transferred automatically to your listed bank account — no action is needed for the refund itself. If you believe any figure (e.g. income, deductions) is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) against this assessment; the app shows until when you can still do so, counted from when this letter counted as delivered. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final. Keep this document for your records, as it states your taxable income and deductions, which can be useful for other applications.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with any figure in this assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterweiler in writing or electronically, or declare it there for the record, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you take no action by the deadline shown, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
